CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_credit_score(
    p_credscore numeric,
    p_credutil numeric,
    p_debincratio numeric,
    p_credageyrs numeric,
    p_delinqcount numeric,
    p_latepaycount numeric,
    p_choffs numeric,
    p_bankr numeric
) RETURNS numeric AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN (
        0.4 * LEAST(CAST(p_credscore / 850 AS numeric), 1.0)
        + 0.2 * LEAST(CAST(1 - p_credutil AS numeric), 1.0)
        + 0.2 * LEAST(CAST(1 - p_debincratio AS numeric), 1.0)
        + 0.1 * LEAST(CAST(p_credageyrs / 20 AS numeric), 1.0)
        + 0.1 * LEAST(CAST(1 - (p_delinqcount + p_latepaycount + p_choffs + p_bankr) / 10 AS numeric), 1.0)
    );
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

SELECT 
    cr.coreregistry AS record_id,
    cr.clientref AS customer_id,
    cac.credutil,
    cac.credlimusage,
    eai.debincratio,
    ccc.credscore,
    ccc.credageyrs,
    ccc.delinqcount,
    ccc.latepaycount,
    ccc.choffs,
    ccc.bankr
FROM core_record cr
JOIN employment_and_income eai ON cr.coreregistry = eai.emplcoreref
JOIN expenses_and_assets ea ON eai.emplcoreref = ea.expemplref
JOIN bank_and_transactions bt ON ea.expemplref = bt.bankexpref
JOIN credit_and_compliance ccc ON bt.bankexpref = ccc.compbankref
JOIN credit_accounts_and_history cac ON ccc.compbankref = cac.histcompref
WHERE cr.decidestat = 'Approved'
ORDER BY cac.credutil DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    cr.coreregistry AS record_id,
    cr.clientref AS customer_id,
    calculate_credit_health_score(
        ccc.credscore,
        cac.credutil,
        eai.debincratio,
        ccc.credageyrs,
        ccc.delinqcount,
        ccc.latepaycount,
        ccc.choffs,
        ccc.bankr
    ) AS chs
FROM core_record cr
JOIN employment_and_income eai ON cr.coreregistry = eai.emplcoreref
JOIN expenses_and_assets ea ON eai.emplcoreref = ea.expemplref
JOIN bank_and_transactions bt ON ea.expemplref = bt.bankexpref
JOIN credit_and_compliance ccc ON bt.bankexpref = ccc.compbankref
JOIN credit_accounts_and_history cac ON ccc.compbankref = cac.histcompref
WHERE cr.decidestat = 'Approved'
ORDER BY chs DESC
LIMIT 5;

    ) AS chs
FROM core_record cr
JOIN employment_and_income eai ON cr.coreregistry = eai.emplcoreref

JOIN bank_and_transactions bt ON ea.expemplref = bt.bankexpref
